scope: All 30 changed paths inventoried. Functional social, authentication, privacy and quarantine changes reviewed directly; client integration, CSS and verifier changes inspected for context and coverage. This is an adversarial break verdict, not exhaustive certification or a fresh mobile/build test. Unlike the legacy 24k-character prompt, review included backend code beyond the opening CSS/client diff.

findings.claim: The newly added case-sensitive namespace checks in DirMods and media-server quarantine skip uppercase paths that default case-insensitive Express routes still match; the owner-only quarantine can be bypassed using /api/DIRMODS or /api/MEDIASERVERS paths.
findings.evidence: Exact namespace regex extraction: lowercase passes; uppercase returns false for both namespaces. Real Express Router matches the uppercase endpoint path in both cases, proving the routing mismatch. Prior quarantine middleware was unconditional.

findings.claim: New follow/privacy policy wiring fails open when its backing state cannot be read: a throwing block lookup still permits a follow mutation and a throwing privacy lookup still returns another account's private follower list.
findings.evidence: Exact committed route factory with failure-injected dependencies returns success=true and performs one follow write after a block exception; privacy exception returns private-follower rows. The preexisting database isUserBlocked accessor also catches errors as false, so repair must preserve failure information end to end, not only adjust the new wrapper. Shared-cards uses the same new default-visible catch pattern.

findings.claim: The new unseen-count SQL omits the bidirectional block filter used by the following feed, so posts from a blocked author still increase the viewer's unread badge even though no corresponding feed card is visible.
findings.evidence: Exact unseen-count SQL executed against an in-memory SQLite fixture: viewer follows author, author blocks viewer, one public card exists; unseen returns 1 instead of 0.
